call_points.text: FY27 order inflow targeted at ₹15,900 Cr, aiming to end the year with a ₹24,000 Cr order book.
Sustainable EBITDA margin seen at around 16%.
Working capital targeted to reduce by at least 20% this year.
R&D spend to be maintained at around 7% of revenue.
Aditya facility adds 100 metro coaches per year or 50-70 high-speed coaches per year.
FY27 opportunity pipeline of around ₹40,000 Cr, 70% from rail and metro.
Rail and metro execution expected at ₹2,000 Cr this year, with order inflow of ₹10,000 Cr.
Defence execution expected at ₹1,500-2,000 Cr this year.
FY26 margin hit by ₹250 Cr one-time correction and gratuity provision; these are non-recurring.
Receivables to reduce first in M&C segment; defence payments already received in April-May.
Raw material price pressure expected from conflict, partly mitigated by PVC clauses.
International business carries payment and political risks; Oman repeat order on hold.
